items.summary: Out-of-band security updates for .NET address the Brotli decoder vulnerability and tarball ownership vulnerability. The post .NET October 2026 Out-of-Band Security Updates appeared first on .NET Blog .
items.content: Today, we are releasing out-of-band (OOB) security updates for .NET 8, .NET 9, and .NET 10, along with .NET 11 Release Candidate 3. We recommend updating as soon as possible. Security updates This out-of-band release addresses CVE-2026-111497 , a vulnerability in the Brotli decompression algorithm . It also includes a fix for CVE-2026-114148 (Linux .NET tarball ownership) in .NET 8, 9, 10, and 11.

items.title: Unpatched Tailscale SSH Flaws Could Let a Hacked Device Reach Root on Other Servers
items.summary: A single hacked device on a Tailscale network can be used to gain root access to other servers it can reach, according to a security researcher who published the findings this week. The attack requires two things: Tailscale SSH set up to allow port forwarding, and an attacker who already controls one device that the network's access rules permit to connect to the target. items.title: Gheist: Attempted Scaled Abuse of Stolen GitHub Tokens Stumbles
items.summary: An automated campaign is planting secret-dumping workflows in every repository that stolen GitHub tokens can reach. It uses no C2 server, is actively evolving, and has been significantly disrupted by recent GitHub security improvements.
